NewsArticle.Title: The Pact: Natesh Awakened
NewsArticle.Content: The Tulsi began to bloom, but something was wrong. The sodden swamp earth quivered. What humans call "Dubhaimid" spawned from the green of the swamp earth, and flying forms came from the sky. Dubhaimid blacken the earth and sky in Mehadi swamp, Loures Castle, Piet, and Rucesion. They are servants of Natesh. Natesh is angry and has not been offered the Tulsi blossom that we offer to It. Natesh has been awakened from Its slumber beneath the swamp. The Tulsi is in bloom. The heart of Mehadi Swamp is now beautiful with flowers, but outside, all is dark. Varuna, -Vibha Rishi Mukul, What humans call Keeper of Time of the Mukul culture of Mehadi Swamp (( Tulsi blooms 99.10.29 through 99.10.31 ))
